help.title: Help center
help.faq1Q: How do I track my order?
help.faq1A: Go to My Orders and tap on any order to see its real-time tracking status. You'll also get push notifications at every step.
help.faq2A: Standard delivery takes 2-3 days within Kathmandu Valley. Express delivery is available same-day for orders placed before 2 PM.
help.faq3A: Yes! You can return most products within 7 days of delivery. Go to your order, tap 'Return' and follow the steps. Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days.
help.faq4Q: What payment methods do you accept?
help.faq4A: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), Khalti, and eSewa. You can manage your payment methods in Profile > Payment Methods.
help.faq5Q: How do I get a refund?
help.faq5A: Refunds are automatically processed when a return is approved. For COD orders, we'll transfer to your Khalti/eSewa wallet. For online payments, the refund goes back to the original payment method.
help.faq6Q: How do I change my phone number?
help.faq6A: Go to Settings > Change phone number. You'll need to verify the new number with an OTP code.
help.faq7Q: How do I delete my account?
help.faq7A: Go to Settings > Delete account. This action is permanent and cannot be undone. All your data including orders, wishlist, and addresses will be removed.
help.faq8Q: Is Cash on Delivery available everywhere?
help.faq8A: COD is available in Kathmandu Valley and major cities. For other areas, we recommend using Khalti or eSewa for a smoother experience.

about.description: Chinooz is Nepal's trusted marketplace connecting you with thousands of local sellers. From electronics to handicrafts, groceries to fashion — everything you need, delivered to your doorstep.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: By accessing or using Chinooz, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use our platform.
terms.s2Body: You must provide accurate information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account.
terms.s3Body: All orders are subject to availability and confirmation. Prices are displayed in Nepali Rupees (NPR) and include applicable taxes. We reserve the right to cancel orders in case of pricing errors or stock unavailability.
terms.s4Body: Delivery times are estimates and may vary. Chinooz is not liable for delays caused by factors beyond our control. Risk of loss transfers to you upon delivery.
terms.s5Body: Most products can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Certain items (perishables, personal care, underwear) are non-returnable. Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days after return approval.
terms.s6Body: You may not use Chinooz for any unlawful purpose, to resell products without authorization, to manipulate prices or reviews, or to harass other users or sellers.
terms.s7Body: Chinooz acts as a marketplace platform. We are not liable for the quality, safety, or legality of products listed by sellers. Our total liability is limited to the amount you paid for the relevant order.
terms.s8Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of Chinooz after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: We collect information you provide directly: name, phone number, email, delivery address, and payment details. We also collect usage data such as pages visited, searches, and device information.
privacy.s2Body: We use your information to process orders, provide customer support, improve our platform, send order updates and promotional messages (with your consent), and prevent fraud.
privacy.s3Body: We share your information with sellers (to fulfill orders), delivery partners (to deliver your orders), and payment processors (to process payments). We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.s4Body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacy.s5Body: You can access, update, or delete your personal information at any time through your account settings. You can also opt out of promotional messages.
privacy.s6Body: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience, analyze usage, and personalize content. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings.
privacy.s7Body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@chinooz.com or through the Contact Us page in the app.

gs1.title: How do I go online and start receiving deliveries?
gs1.body: Open the Home tab and flip the online switch at the top. Once you are online, nearby delivery requests appear on your screen automatically. You can go offline anytime — you will not be penalised for stepping away.

gs2.title: How do I accept a delivery request?
gs2.body: When a request arrives it appears as a card showing the payout, pickup and drop-off areas. Tap Accept to take the job. You have a few seconds to decide before it passes to the next rider. If you miss it, another will come soon.

gs3.title: What zones can I deliver in?
gs3.body: You deliver in the zone you selected during onboarding. You can change your zone from Profile, then Personal profile. Trips stay short by design so you ride near home and spend less fuel.

del1.title: What do I do at pickup?
del1.body: Arrive at the store, confirm the order details match, and tap Confirm pickup in the active delivery screen. The app then switches to the drop-off leg. If the item is wrong or missing, tap Issue with pickup in trip help.

del2.title: What if the buyer is not at drop-off?
del2.body: Wait 5 minutes and try calling the buyer from the active delivery screen. If they still do not answer, tap Issue with buyer in trip help or contact support. Never abandon a delivery without reporting it.

del3.title: How do I cancel a delivery?
del3.body: Open the active delivery screen and tap Cancel. You will be asked to pick a reason. Repeated cancellations affect your completion rate, so only cancel when genuinely necessary.

earn1.title: When do I get paid?
earn1.body: Earnings are paid weekly to your eSewa, Khalti or bank account. You can also cash out your withdrawable balance anytime from the Earnings screen — it usually lands within minutes.

earn2.title: How is my payout calculated?
earn2.body: You earn a base payout per trip plus distance and surge bonuses. Active quests and streaks add extra. Open Earnings, then Trip ledger to see a full breakdown of every trip and bonus.

earn3.title: Why is my payout pending?
earn3.body: Funds from a recent trip are held for 1 to 2 days for verification before they become withdrawable. This is normal and protects everyone. You will see them move from pending to withdrawable automatically.

cod1.title: What is cash in hand?
cod1.body: Cash in hand is buyer money you collected for Cash on Delivery orders. It is owed to Chinooz and must be deposited — it is not your earnings. Open the Cash and COD wallet to see how much to remit.

cod2.title: How do I deposit cash I collected?
cod2.body: Open the Cash and COD wallet and tap Deposit cash. You can deposit at a partner location or transfer to Chinooz. Deposit by the suggested deadline to keep your account in good standing.

cod3.title: What if I lose cash I collected?
cod3.body: Report it immediately via Contact support or SOS if you are unsafe. Cash in hand is your responsibility until deposited. Chinooz will help you file a report and investigate.

acc1.title: Why is my verification pending?
acc1.body: We review your ID, licence and registration after onboarding. This usually takes 1 to 2 days. You can ride while pending in most zones, but some high-value jobs require a verified account.

acc2.title: How do I update my documents?
acc2.body: Go to Profile, then Vehicle and documents to update your bike, licence and registration. Changes may need re-verification before you can take certain jobs. Make sure photos are clear and in date.

acc3.title: How do I change my phone number?
acc3.body: Go to Profile, then Personal profile to update your contact details. A new number must be verified with an OTP code before it takes effect.

safe1.title: What does SOS do?
safe1.body: SOS shares your live location and trip details with your trusted contacts and the Chinooz safety team. Press and hold the SOS button for 3 seconds to activate. A safety agent will call you shortly after.

safe2.title: What if I have an accident on a delivery?
safe2.body: Stay calm. Activate SOS immediately, then call emergency services from the SOS screen. Chinooz safety will be notified and will reach out. Use trip help on the Support and Safety screen for quick actions.

safe3.title: How do I share my trip with a contact?
safe3.body: Tap Share trip status on the Support and Safety screen to let a trusted contact follow your delivery in real time. You can also share from an active delivery. Sharing stops when the trip ends.

performance.detailSubtitle: How each metric is measured and where it's heading
performance.detailRatingDef: The average star rating customers gave your completed deliveries. One number that sums up how riders felt about your service.
performance.detailAcceptanceDef: The share of delivery requests you accepted out of all that were sent to you. Declining occasionally is fine — this just shows how often you said yes.
performance.detailCompletionDef: The share of accepted deliveries you completed. It counts deliveries that finished, regardless of why the rest didn't.
performance.detailOnTimeDef: The share of completed deliveries that arrived within the promised time window. Traffic and pickup waits can affect this.
performance.detailTotalDef: The number of deliveries you completed in this period. It's a count, not a rate.
performance.detailTargetRatingFraming: 4.7 is the bar for good standing. You're above it — nice.
performance.detailTargetAcceptanceFraming: 90% is the bar. Declining far or unsuitable jobs is okay — just accept most.
performance.detailTargetCompletionFraming: 95% is the bar. A couple of cancels are fine over a busy week.
performance.detailTargetOnTimeFraming: 90% is the bar. Traffic and long pickups are the usual culprits when this dips.
performance.detailTargetTotalFraming: A healthy week is around 30 deliveries. There's no penalty for doing fewer.
performance.detailRatingExplainer: Ratings come from customers after a delivery. Friendly contact, careful handling and on-time arrival help most. One low rating barely moves your average when you've done hundreds of rides.
performance.detailAcceptanceExplainer: Acceptance drops when you decline or let requests expire. It's fine to decline jobs that are too far or unsafe — your acceptance only needs to stay above 90% to keep good standing.
performance.detailCompletionExplainer: Completion falls when an accepted delivery is cancelled by you or the customer, or the customer can't be reached. Most cancellations are customer-side; only rider-side cancels affect your standing.
performance.detailOnTimeExplainer: On-time drops when traffic, long pickup distances or slow handoffs push you past the ETA window. Starting pickup promptly and choosing familiar routes helps the most.
performance.detailTotalExplainer: Your total depends on how long you're online and how many requests you accept. More online hours in busy zones usually means more deliveries — but there's no minimum.
